text:
mira: quick check 2 proposing a "scanline" compact row (thin separator) for the compare table to save vertical space. dropping a tiny prototype gif: https://imgur.com/proto123. thoughts on readability, focus, and the pin affordance?

ben: I like the compact scanline for dense lists. only worry: when there are many metrics the rows feel cramped and numbers can collide. consider fixed-width metric columns.

carol: accessibility note: scanlines reduce visual separation for low-vision users. if we keep them, bump contrast of separator to at least 3:1. also ensure row focus is prominent.

evan: pin behavior question  should pin be per-collection (catalog) or global account? i vote account-level so people see same pinned versions across devices. we'll need backend support and an icon state.

mira: agreed on account-level. microcopy for toggle aria-label ideas: "Pin model to compare" / "Unpin model from compare". keep toast: "Pinned to your account" (1.8s).

carol: implementation a11y: use `role=\"row\"` and one focusable element per row (roving tabindex). pin button itself should be `aria-pressed` and update an `aria-live` polite region with "Pinned to compare". avoid hover-only interactions.

ben: visual nit: badges (perf/latency) currently use color only. add a tiny glyph + abbreviated text, e.g., \"G\"/\"Y\"/\"R\" or icons. legend in header should be keyboard reachable and open a small dialog with thresholds.

evan: focus outline  2px solid brand, no heavy shadow in dense mode. test on mac + NVDA.

ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: contrast for separators, roving tabindex, aria-pressed, aria-live updates, legend dialog reachable, no hover-only reveals.

mira: thanks all  i'll update the figma (compact / regular) and add an "accessibility notes" page with required attributes. will open PR and tag @carol and @ben for review. react with :thumbsup: for compact scanline, :eyes: for keep full spacing.
